purpose: Measure the n=8 MMQ/MMVQ crossover against locked SM clocks on one L20, on the same source as the 9 Oct 810-vs-default run
prior_anchor: 9 Oct L20 result at 810 MHz on this commit stays outside this paired estimate

probe.workload: 8B Q4_0, selected and cutoff7, n=8, 30 repeats
probe.accept: every busy sample of both binaries within +/-15 MHz
probe.grid: a grid lock that fails is omitted, not relabeled
probe.high: descending candidates; keep the first that holds; stop after it
probe.stop: 1200 MHz must hold, and at least three locks must hold, before the paired sweep

timing.route_controls: n=1 and n=16 once at the lowest and highest accepted locks, both 8B files, three worlds
timing.small_model: 1B Q8_0 at the per-type boundary locks only, six rounds, n=8, after the 8B curve is reduced
timing.order: rotate clock, world, and file order by round
timing.memory_clock: do not change; more than 1% difference across accepted locks makes the run inconclusive

analysis.estimate: paired geometric mean of cutoff7/selected and 95% percentile bootstrap, Random(0), 10000 resamples
analysis.null_floor: absolute paired geometric-mean deviation of null_rebuild/selected at n=8; must be <=2% for that lock to stay in the curve
analysis.material_win: control passes, ratio >= 1.03, all six rounds above 1, and the bootstrap lower bound above 1
analysis.material_loss: control passes, ratio <= 0.97, all six rounds below 1, and the bootstrap upper bound below 1
analysis.crossover: lowest adjacent pair that changes from a material win to not a material win; Q4_0 and Q8_0 stay separate; a later win after a loss is nonmonotonic and is not averaged into one cutoff
analysis.decision: CURVE_READY_FOR_REVIEW only with 1200 MHz valid, at least three valid locks, route controls within 2%, and no thermal or memory-clock failure. This decision is not a portable rule and is not a llama.cpp patch.
